manual_diagnostic_read.sample: first 20 canonical candidate rows; diagnostic only, not randomized or inferential
manual_diagnostic_read.finding: Visible titles included security-news aggregation, unrelated support requests, and repeated repositories alongside plausible maintenance records.
manual_diagnostic_read.implication: Keyword search is useful candidate discovery but cannot supply eligibility, stratum labels, or an independent population without immutable-source review and lineage collapse.

visibility_audit.interpretation: The pilot proves authenticated GitHub Search transport only. It does not prove that every returned repository was public and must not be used as a public population receipt.

public_record_privacy_scan.scanner_scope: candidate rows and immutable raw GitHub response bytes
public_record_privacy_scan.interpretation: This is a public-source privacy finding, not evidence that the operator credential was serialized and not proof that the token-shaped value is live.

protocol_correction.finding: GitHub omitted ETag on both live Search API pages while providing Date, Link, request ID, rate-limit metadata, and stable response bytes.
protocol_correction.change: V2 query contracts now require an explicit null when ETag is absent and use body digests plus repeated acquisitions for drift detection instead of pretending ETag is always available.
